task_description: Session memory review: Check for idle conversations (no messages in 10+ min after active chat). If idle, write a session summary to memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD_HH.md. Include: what was discussed, what was done, decisions made, open items. Extract any new user preferences, feedback, or failed approaches into memory files. Background task, don't message the user.
Check for pending admin tasks: call list_pending_tasks, process any that are assigned to you. Execute the task, then mark it complete. This is how the admin agent communicates with you.

Heartbeat check: Verify core systems are functional. Check MCP server connectivity (call my_skills), vault access (call get_credential for a known key), and disk space. If anything is down, log to memory/sessions/ and alert the user via their preferred channel.

Token refresh: Check OAuth tokens for connected services (Google, Microsoft, etc.). If any token expires within the next 2 hours, refresh it using the refresh_token grant and update both the vault and disk copy. Log refreshes to memory/sessions/.
QMD index refresh: If QMD is installed, run 'qmd update && qmd embed' to re-index memory files, skills, and docs for semantic search. Skip silently if QMD is not available.
note: Enable after installing QMD (optional on-device semantic search)

task_description: Security audit: Run the security watch script to scan for suspicious file changes, unauthorized workspace access, and unexpected processes. Check for modified CLAUDE.md or .mcp.json files (tampering indicators). Log findings to memory/sessions/. Alert the user immediately if anything suspicious is found.

Inbox check: If Gmail is connected, scan all connected email accounts for unread messages. Flag anything important or actionable to the user via their preferred channel. Stay quiet if nothing notable. Background task.
note: Enable after connecting Gmail via gmail_connect.py

task_description: Daily digest: Compile a summary of today's activity — sessions held, tasks completed, memories saved, scheduled tasks that ran, any errors or alerts. Send a brief digest to the user via their preferred channel. Include any open items or things that need their attention tomorrow.

Daily memory compaction: Review today's session summaries in memory/sessions/. Merge overlapping sessions from the same day into a single daily summary file (YYYY-MM-DD.md). Deduplicate any memory files that were created with near-identical content during the day. Update MEMORY.md index if any memories were merged or removed. Prune session files older than 30 days (keep the daily summary, delete the hourly ones).

Weekly memory review: Deep review of all memory files. Check for: (1) Stale project memories — projects that were completed or abandoned, mark them or remove. (2) Contradictory feedback — newer feedback that supersedes older feedback, merge them. (3) Outdated references — external resources that may have moved or changed. (4) MEMORY.md index health — ensure all entries point to real files, no orphans, under 200 lines. (5) Write a weekly memory health report to memory/sessions/YYYY-MM-DD_weekly.md. This is deep maintenance, not a quick scan.
